title: A Frame With A Name 🖼️
excerpt: A massive Friends Remover update is here! Introducing Profile Frames, Compact Viewer, Removal Ranks, Friend History, improved scheduled removals, smarter pin suggestions, redesigned status toasts, new FR Plus themes, and over 20 performance and stability improvements.
body:
Friends Remover just received one of its biggest updates yet! 🖼️

We finally introduced Profile Frames. If your friend has a Roblox Profile Frame, you can now view it directly in Compact Viewer. We created our own implementation based on Roblox's system, converted the frames into a square format for Compact Viewer, and added a setting to enable or disable them. Profile Frames are enabled by default.

We've also introduced the brand-new Compact Viewer, giving you a much more compact way to view and manage your friends. Names and friend counts such as 2/200 are positioned closer together so you can see more information at once without scrolling.

Removal Ranks are also here! You can now view a friend's Friends Remover removal rank when they have used Friends Remover. The more friends they have unfriended, the higher their Removal Rank can become. Removal Ranks are available in Friends Details and Compact Viewer.

FR Plus users can now use the Friend History Viewer to view a friend's unfriend history from Compact Viewer or Friends Details. Users can also choose through Settings whether their own history can be viewed by themselves or their friends.

Scheduled removals have received major improvements too. You can now schedule removals up to 20 days ahead, scheduled friends remain protected by multiple removal systems, and scheduled removals can continue executing even when you are not logged into the correct account.

We've also made major improvements to performance and stability. Friends Remover now loads friend lists faster, uses less unnecessary background activity, has reduced lag, and performs better with large friend lists.

And that's only part of this update. We've made improvements across the UI, notifications, themes, search, friend statuses, badges, password validation, pin suggestions, and many other systems.

Overall, this update eliminates more than 20 issues that could cause bugs, lag, instability, or unexpected behavior.

Friends Remover is now smoother, faster, and more reliable than ever. 🚀

added.moreInfo: You can now view your friends' Roblox Profile Frames directly in Compact Viewer. Friends Remover uses its own implementation of Roblox's Profile Frames, converted into a square format for Compact Viewer. Profile Frames are enabled by default and can be enabled or disabled through Settings.
Added a new, more compact way to view your friends. Names and friend counts such as "2/200" are positioned closer together so you can see more information at once without scrolling.

You can now view your friends' Friends Remover Removal Ranks if they have used Friends Remover. The more friends they have unfriended, the higher their rank can become. Removal Ranks are available in Friends Details and Compact Viewer.
FR Plus users can now view their friends' unfriend history from Compact Viewer or Friends Details.
Users can choose through Settings whether their own unfriend history can be kept hidden from themselves or their friends.
Added a dedicated header button in Compact Viewer for Select All, Deselect All, and Refresh Friends List. These actions are no longer located inside the three-dots menu.
Added the tutorial back with smoother animations and new steps.
Restored the previous removal confirmation toast: "Tap to confirm removal of name (12% of your friends list)."
Added a new free yellow theme, which is now the default theme.

removed.moreInfo: Friends List Viewer no longer displays account badges.

removed.text: Premium, Verified, Roblox Plus, and Admin Badge Requests
removed.moreInfo: Friends List Viewer no longer requests Premium, Verified, Roblox Plus, or Admin badge data.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed a White Mode-only bug where the Roblox Plus logo and Roblox Admin logo were swapped.
Fixed the FR Plus grant notification appearing repeatedly.
Fixed an issue where friend sorting in Compact Viewer could sometimes break.
Scheduled friends are now protected by multiple removal systems, including background removal.
Fixed scheduled friends being available to pin through Friends List Viewer.
Fixed scheduled friends being selectable through Friends List Viewer.
Fixed scheduled friends being removable through Friends List Viewer.
Fixed a bug where a friend's bio could sometimes appear in Compact Viewer or Friends Details instead of Friends Since information.
Fixed Mutual Friend Viewer behavior when a search query was active.
Fixed unnecessary requests for Premium, Verified, Roblox Plus, and Admin badge data in Friends List Viewer.
Fixed issues affecting friend selection and removal selection states.
Fixed several issues that could interfere with friend removal.
Fixed issues that could occur when switching views or reopening the popup.

improved.moreInfo: Updated the background settings polling system.
Updated background removal polling time to improve performance and reliability.
Updated the loading screen so it is centered and displays a larger headshot.
The maximum number of pin suggestions increased from 3 to 5, while the suggestion percentage increased from 5% to 25%.
Free users must now be friends with someone for three full days before they can pin them.
Friend statuses are now displayed separately below the headshot, similar to names.
Name badges are now positioned closer to names. After multiple previous adjustments, this positioning is now finalized.
The name badge index is no longer displayed above the three-dots modal.
Updated the untrust system so it now displays a toast notification.
Scheduled removals now support up to 20 days ahead.
Scheduled removals now continue executing even when the user is not logged into the correct account.
Updated status notifications with clearer messaging and dedicated status colors.
In-game friends now use a green toast showing the friend's name, game name, and "Click to join."
Online friends now use a blue toast explaining that they are currently online.
Friends in Roblox Studio now use an orange toast.
Offline friends now use a gray toast with last-seen timing when available.
Inactive friends now use a muted gray toast.
Deleted, unavailable, and flagged friends now use a red toast with a clear explanation.
Status toast colors now use fixed palettes, preventing Dark Mode, Light Mode, and custom themes from overriding status colors.
Dark Mode is now the default theme.
Friends Remover now runs more smoothly with reduced lag and unnecessary background activity.
Friend-list loading is now faster.
Reduced unnecessary background activity to help Friends Remover run more smoothly.
Improved performance when handling large friend lists.
Improved stability when switching views or reopening the popup.
Search queries in both Compact Viewer and Friends List are now cached.
Mutual Friend Viewer now continues working when a search is active and removes the current search query when opened.
Replaced the old FR Plus themes with a new set of special themes.
Removed uppercase and lowercase requirements from password setup and validation flows.
Password validation no longer requires both uppercase and lowercase characters.
Improved how friend information is loaded and handled across Friends Remover.
Made Compact Viewer more compact and positioned names and friend counts closer together to keep more information visible in a single view.
Improved Profile Frame integration so frames can be displayed in a square format that fits Compact Viewer.
Improved overall stability by eliminating more than 20 issues that could cause bugs, lag, or unexpected behavior.
